cypher: MATCH (c:DLCommit)-[:DL_MODIFIED_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE c.dataset=$dataset AND c.repo=$repo AND c.sha=$sha AND trim(f.content)<>'' WITH c,f,[line IN split(f.content,'\n') WHERE trim(line)<>''] AS lines RETURN f.path+': '+trim(last(lines)) AS entity,f.path+': '+trim(last(lines)) AS fact,[c.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY f.path LIMIT 5
